_comment: Test-vocal sources for the Velvox benchmark. Audio is NEVER committed to the repository; it is downloaded into the data directory (default %USERPROFILE%/dev/velvox-data). 'approved' lists what the license allows us to do.

sources.name: VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset (v1.1)
sources.attribution: Wilkins, J., Seetharaman, P., Wahl, A., Pardo, B. (2018). VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset. ISMIR 2018. doi:10.5281/zenodo.1442513
restrictions: attribution required if material or derivatives are shared
sources.notes: 20 professional singers (11 male, 9 female), dry studio recordings of scales, arpeggios, long tones and excerpts in many techniques (straight, breathy, belt, vibrato, vocal fry, ...). Not genre-specific pop/EDM performances.

sources.name: Sonovox free vocal dataset demo pack (Sonja)
restrictions: no redistribution or resale of the raw stems
commercial-product use of the demo not explicitly granted - full license is a paid agreement
sources.notes: Dry WAV stems, 25 female / 25 male. Use only for internal evaluation; do not tune shipped defaults exclusively on it until rights are clarified with Sonovox. Archive 5.09 GB (HTTP Content-Length 2026-10-21); the first download of 2026-10-19 was incomplete (1.58 GB) and is resumed.
